title: The Romantic story of the couple
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：romantic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 romantic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the director wrote of ① a romantic story of the couple in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more romantic than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the romantic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most romantic story of the couple anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too romantic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the romantic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a romantic view of the lake, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as romantic as the view of the lake they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was romantic or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something romantic, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite romantic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the romantic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, in silence, she wrote of another romantic story of the couple in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more romantic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most romantic view of the lake in the whole theatre, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the romantic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 浪漫（前置定语 a romantic story of the couple：1969 年导演在戏报里记下的那件浪漫的故事）
B. adj. 浪漫／富有情调（比较级 more romantic than：文中两处，一处比这对恋人的浪漫故事，一处比预想）
C. adj. 浪漫／富有情调（最高级 the most romantic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 浪漫（表语 too romantic to do：母亲觉得它太浪漫，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 富有情调（前置定语 a romantic view of the lake：叔叔把整件事称作一桩富有情调的景致）
F. adj. 富有情调（同级比较 as romantic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩湖上富有情调的景致相比）
G. adj. 富有情调（后置定语 something romantic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 富有情调（受程度副词修饰 quite romantic：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a romantic story of the couple
the most romantic story of the couple anybody
a romantic view of the lake
The most romantic view of the lake in

answers.why: romantic 意为“浪漫”，1969 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件浪漫的故事”，此处作前置定语 a romantic story of the couple。
romantic 意为“浪漫”，此处用比较级 more romantic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
romantic 意为“浪漫”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最浪漫的一件，故用最高级 the most romantic story of the couple。
romantic 意为“浪漫”，母亲认为这件东西“太浪漫了，谁也用不上”，too romantic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩富有情调的景致”，此处作前置定语 a romantic view of the lake。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩湖上富有情调的景致一样富有情调”，同级比较用 as romantic as。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，戏报上那半行字要的是“富有情调的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something romantic。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当富有情调”，quite 修饰原级 romantic。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，1979 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要富有情调”，故用比较级 more romantic than。
romantic 意为“富有情调”，母亲 1981 年说的是“整个戏院里最富有情调的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most romantic view of the lake。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件浪漫的故事。（a romantic story of the couple）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更浪漫。（more romantic than …）
母亲觉得它太浪漫，谁也用不上。（too romantic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩富有情调的景致。（a romantic view of the lake）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩湖上富有情调的景致一样富有情调。（as romantic as …）
到了 1976 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件富有情调的东西。（something romantic）
answers: In 1969 the director wrote of a romantic story of the couple in the poster.
Everybody said it was more romantic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too romantic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a romantic view of the lake.
He said nobody would call it as romantic as the view of the lake they had once had.
By 1976 the poster asked for nothing but something romantic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 romantic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the director wrote of a romantic story of the couple in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most romantic story of the couple in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too romantic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a romantic view of the lake, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite romantic, and everybody laughed.
The romantic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
